# Data Integrity Checklist: Mission Control Product-Line Seed and Flag Activation

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009B requirements and plan artifacts fully define seed idempotency, row identity, metadata preservation, workflow import integrity, governance uniqueness, and blocked-preflight non-mutation.
**Created**: 2026-05-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the Product Line A and Facility workspace identities fully specified, including the exact `mission-control` and `facility` slugs and the prohibition on reusing Facility as Product Line A? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §Facility Workspace, Data Model §Mission Control Product Line]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all six required department rows defined with stable slugs, ticket prefixes, area slugs, triage ownership, and repository sync-owner expectations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-029, Data Model §Department Project]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all required role-to-agent assignment rows specified with stable role and `agent_name` identities without relying on a `project_agent_assignments.workspace_id` column? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §Agent Role Assignment]
- [ ] CHK004 Are Mission Control GitHub issue-intake records defined by durable identity fields and preservation requirements for linkage and sync metadata? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §Mission Control Issue Intake]
- [ ] CHK005 Are required workflow-template slugs for both Issue Triage and Issue Remediation completely enumerated and tied to the repo-owned workflow contract path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Workflow Family Templates]
- [ ] CHK006 Are conservative governance policy identities, field values, and duplicate-prevention expectations specified for all SPEC-009B-owned policy rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-034, Data Model §Governance Policy]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the seed rerun idempotency requirement expressed with objective stable-count expectations across Product Line, Facility, departments, assignments, workflows, flags, governance rows, and preserved issue intake? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-033, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the QA department's dual role as triage/inbox destination and repository sync owner unambiguous, including the exclusion of a separate Triage project? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, Spec §SC-011, Data Model §Department Project]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between preserving existing Mission Control issue projections and creating new pilot tasks clear enough to prevent count drift on rerun? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-012, Data Model §Mission Control Issue Intake]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the blocked-preflight result shape defined with `code`, `mutation_status: "not_mutated"`, redacted residue summaries, and cleanup checklist reference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Blocked Preflight Result]
- [ ] CHK011 Is workflow-contract failure behavior clear when the repo-owned contract is stale, incomplete, or missing required Mission Control slugs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Contract Readiness Failure]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the canonical `PILOT_MISSION_CONTROL_E2E` flag distinguished from legacy `PILOT_PRODUCT_LINE_A_E2E` drift without allowing a second persisted pilot flag? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §Feature Flag Set]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Do the spec, plan, data model, and CLI contract consistently require preflight to run before any seed mutation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Implementation Approach, Contract §Modes]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the spec and data model consistently define `(workspace_id, slug)`, `(project_id, agent_name, role)`, `(workspace_id, slug)`, and `(workspace_id, notes)` as idempotency identities for departments, assignments, workflow templates, and governance rows? [Consistency, Data Model §Department Project, Data Model §Agent Role Assignment, Data Model §Workflow Family Templates, Data Model §Governance Policy]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the governance requirements consistently keep token/USD budget policies enabled and non-blocking while keeping WIP visibility evaluator-inactive unless non-blocking behavior is proven? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, Spec §FR-035, Spec §SC-008, Spec §SC-014]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the issue-intake and non-dispatch requirements align so preserved GitHub issue tasks can be re-homed without being claimed, dispatched, marked complete, or duplicated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-032]

- [ ] CHK020 Are governance non-blocking outcomes measurable through absence of `defer:wip_limit`, `block:hard_budget_exceeded`, blackout, and degraded-window decisions for normal pilot intake? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-014, Data Model §Governance Policy]
